gloss: wind band music; brass band music

definitions.gloss: wind band music; brass band; concert band music
definitions.explanation: Music performed by an ensemble of wind instruments (woodwinds and brass) and percussion, or the ensemble itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}→吹奏楽部：27464_suisougakubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I joined the wind band club in middle school.

examples.english: We won a gold prize at the wind band competition.

examples.japanese: {吹奏楽|すいそうがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定期演奏会|ていきえんそうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{吹奏|すいそう}→吹奏：22729_suisou⟧ (playing wind instruments) + {楽|がく} (music)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{吹奏楽|すいそうがく} is extremely popular in Japanese schools. Most middle schools and high schools have a ⟦{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}→吹奏楽部：27464_suisougakubu⟧ (wind band club), and competitions like the {全日本|ぜんにほん}{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧ are major annual events.
